subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Meghalaya.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Shillong. Meghalaya covers a geographic area of 22,429 sq km across 12 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Umiam, Umngot (Dawki - crystal clear river), Simsang, Kopili.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: Known as the 'Abode of Clouds'. Home to Mawsynram (the wettest place on Earth), living root bridges handmade by Khasi tribes, and a matrilineal social lineage system.

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Meghalaya.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Meghalaya was formally instituted on 21 January 1972. Official language(s): English, Khasi, Garo.

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Shad Suk Mynsiem, Nongkrem Dance, Wangala (Hundred Drums Festival).

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Wangala Festival, Shad Suk Mynsiem, Behdeinkhlam.

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Meghalaya.

facts.title: Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Governor is C. H. Vijayashankar.

facts.title: Chief Minister & Administration
facts.content: The Chief Minister of Meghalaya is Conrad Sangma.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under High Court of Meghalaya (Shillong).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Clouded leopard | State Bird: Hill myna | State Flower: Lady's slipper orchid | State Tree: White teak (Gamhar).

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Meghalaya.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Coal, Limestone, Uranium (Domiasiat), Sillimanite.

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Meghalaya plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Meghalaya.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Living Root Bridges of Cherrapunji, Nohkalikai Falls (tallest plunge waterfall in India, 340m), Mawsmai Cave.

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Balphakram National Park, Nokrek National Park (UNESCO Biosphere Reserve).

subtopics.name: State Schemes & Awards
subtopics.summary: Prominent welfare schemes, civic initiatives, and state honors of Meghalaya.

facts.title: Key State Welfare Schemes
facts.content: Notable welfare initiatives and government programs: FOCUS Scheme, Meghalaya Health Insurance Scheme (MHIS).
